bld_extractor.name: Extractor
bld_extractor.description: Built on a resource node. Produces whatever the node yields.

bld_splitter.name: Splitter
bld_splitter.description: Sends one incoming flow out several sides.

bld_merger.name: Merger
bld_merger.description: Joins several flows of the same kind into one.

bld_crossover.name: Crossover
bld_crossover.description: Lets two flows pass each other at right angles.

bld_range.name: Range
bld_range.description: Consumes {res_a} to train archers, ranged units that shoot enemies from a distance, flying ones included.

bld_hangar.name: Hangar
bld_hangar.description: Consumes {res_b} to build drones, flying units that cross walls and lakes and shoot ground and air targets.

bld_gate.name: Gate
bld_gate.description: Blocks enemies but lets your own units through.

bld_turret.name: Turret
bld_turret.description: Needs {res_b} to fire at enemy units on your side.

bld_overclocker.name: Overclocker
bld_overclocker.description: Consumes {res_c} to make sources faster for the rest of the battle.

bld_armory.name: Armory
bld_armory.description: Consumes {res_a} to make units spawned later in the battle stronger.

bld_core.name: Core
bld_core.description: Your party's health. If it falls, the battle is lost.

unit_soldier.name: Soldier
unit_soldier.description: Marches on the enemy Core and attacks whatever blocks the way.

unit_raider.name: Raider
unit_raider.description: Small, fast and fragile: marches on the enemy Core like a soldier.

unit_archer.name: Archer
unit_archer.description: Shoots enemies from a distance, flying ones too. Stops to fire when something is in range.

unit_drone.name: Drone
unit_drone.description: Flies straight at the enemy Core over walls and lakes. Only ranged units and turrets can hit it.

ter_lake.name: Lake
ter_lake.description: Impassable water. Nothing can be built on it.

ter_cliff.name: Cliff
ter_cliff.description: An impassable ridge. Nothing can be built on it.

arch_rusher.name: Rusher
arch_rusher.description: Heavy waves from the first seconds against a stronghold with almost no defenses.

arch_fortress.name: Fortress
arch_fortress.description: A heavily defended stronghold ringed with walls and turrets. Light waves that arrive late.

arch_escalator.name: Escalator
arch_escalator.description: Waves that grow quickly, behind a line of walls and turrets.

arch_boss.name: Boss
arch_boss.description: A strong stronghold with steady waves and a signature unit every few waves.

effects.unit_strength: +{step}% unit strength per {cost} {resource} supplied, up to +{max}% · {health} health

screens.battleGenericAttacker: A tie on {core} health, on damage dealt to the enemy's buildings and on enemy units killed; the attacker (the party) wins.
screens.battleGenericBuildingDamage: A tie on {core} health (both {core}s destroyed in the same tick with equal overkill damage, or equal {core}s standing and equal shares of total health at the time limit); the side that dealt more damage to the enemy's buildings wins.
screens.battleGenericCoreDestroyed: One side's last {core} was destroyed; the other side wins.
screens.battleGenericKills: A tie on {core} health and on damage dealt to the enemy's buildings; the side that killed more enemy units wins.
screens.battleGenericOverkill: Both sides lost their last {core} in the same tick; the side whose {core}s took less overkill damage wins.
screens.battleGenericTimeLimit: Time ran out; the side with more {core}s standing wins, then the side with the larger share of its total {core} health left.
screens.battleTieAttackerDouble: Both sides lost their last {core} in the same tick with equal overkill damage, equal damage to the enemy's buildings and equal kills; the attacker (the party) wins.
screens.battleTieAttackerTime: Time ran out with equal {core}s standing and equal shares of total {core} health, equal damage to the enemy's buildings and equal kills; the attacker (the party) wins.
screens.battleTieBuildingDamageDouble: Both sides lost their last {core} in the same tick with equal overkill damage; the side that dealt more damage to the enemy's buildings wins.
screens.battleTieBuildingDamageTime: Time ran out with equal {core}s standing and equal shares of total {core} health; the side that dealt more damage to the enemy's buildings wins.
screens.battleTieKillsDouble: Both sides lost their last {core} in the same tick with equal overkill damage and equal damage to the enemy's buildings; the side that killed more enemy units wins.
screens.battleTieKillsTime: Time ran out with equal {core}s standing and equal shares of total {core} health and equal damage to the enemy's buildings; the side that killed more enemy units wins.
screens.battleTieOverkillTime: Time ran out with equal {core}s standing and equal shares of total {core} health; the side whose {core}s took less overkill damage wins.
screens.battleTimeLargerShare: Time ran out with equal {core}s standing. The side with the larger share of its total {core} health left wins: yours {ownhealth} / {ownmax}, theirs {foehealth} / {foemax}.
screens.battleTimeMoreCores: Time ran out. The side with more {core}s standing wins: yours {own}, theirs {foe}.
